objective: Design action-value training loss using backend-labeled oracle action groups and validate with the fixed oracle checkpoint gate.

summary.method: Separate oracle-action finetune script using pointwise SmoothL1 and pairwise logistic ranking loss on fixed oracle groups.
summary.default_training: Freeze encoder/dynamics/hard heads; train reward_head and return_head first.
summary.validation: Compare candidate checkpoint to incumbent with scripts/evaluate_oracle_action_values.py on held-out oracle_actions.tsv.
